'''April 2001 Fond du Lac tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Chimaera comic and card place, Fon Du Lac, Wisconsin on 14 April 2001. Derek won it. It is known from Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2108">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-18-fon-du-lac-wi-4-14-01d2108/ fon-du-lac-wi-4-14-01], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 18 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-18-fon-du-lac-wi-4-14-01d2108/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Chimaera comic and card place, Fon Du Lac, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' Derek
